title: Dubai — 5N / 6D

days.title: Welcome to Sparkling Dubai
days.prose: Touch down in the city of gold and enjoy a seamless private transfer to your hotel. Settle into your comfortable room and catch your first glimpses of the dazzling skyline as you prepare for the adventures ahead.

days.title: Historic Sights and Towering Heights
days.prose: Discover the city's rich heritage and modern wonders on a private tour before ascending to the clouds. You will marvel at the breathtaking panoramic vistas from the Burj Khalifa At the Top and enjoy the thrilling glass-floor experience at Sky Views.

days.title: A Relaxing Day of Discovery
days.prose: Enjoy a leisurely day exploring Dubai at your own family's pace. Perhaps wander through the vibrant souks, relax by the hotel pool, or treat yourselves to some world-class shopping and dining.

days.title: Cultural Wonders of Abu Dhabi
days.prose: Journey to the UAE's capital for an immersive shared tour of Abu Dhabi's most iconic landmarks. You will stand in awe of the majestic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and marvel at the city's stunning waterfront corniche.

days.title: Sunshine and Leisure in Dubai
days.prose: Take this free day to soak up the warm Arabian sun or visit one of Dubai's famous family-friendly theme parks. From beachside relaxation to delicious local dining, the city is yours to enjoy to the fullest.

days.title: Fond Farewells to the Emirates
days.prose: Enjoy your final morning in the city before your private seven-seater transfer arrives to take you to the airport. Reflect on your incredible family memories as you head home.
